title: Modular data center startup Rune raised a $40M Series A led by Spark Capital to deploy off-grid compute capacity directly at solar and renewable energy sites (Adele Peters/Fast Company)
summary: Adele Peters / Fast Company: Modular data center startup Rune raised a $40M Series A led by Spark Capital to deploy off-grid compute capacity directly at solar and renewable energy sites — A new data center in southwest Texas isn't connected to the grid—but it also didn't require building any new power plants.
